# Kronos Fusion Energy — Publications
> The 2026 design series: five open-access, reproducible papers plus one complete volume.

## Papers

- [A Deuterium–Helium-3 Tandem-Mirror Generator with Direct Energy Conversion: Closure and Named Extrapolations](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/publications/generator.html): doi:10.5281/zenodo.21746479 (CC BY 4.0). A low-neutron D–³He generator that closes its power balance on measured component efficiencies, with every extrapolation beyond demonstrated hardware named rather than hidden. Introduces a new physics
